events.headline: Kospi sinks 7-8% (briefly below 6,000, ~21% off Sept high) as Samsung and SK Hynix plunge on reports Chinese rival CXMT is closing the memory-chip gap, plus AI-financing/debt-sustainability worries

Chipmaker selloff sends investors into bonds and defensives for safety; US-listed Micron, SK Hynix extend declines as worries about rising borrowing costs for the AI buildout and Fed rate-hike risk mount
Houthis claim fresh missile/projectile attacks on Saudi oil tankers in the Red Sea and Strait of Hormuz, opening a new shipping chokepoint risk alongside ongoing Iran-linked tanker incidents
